description:
FOUND AND FIXED s501q while probing #2515's breaking cases.  PRE-EXISTING on main 77212b1f.
    sub c1 { my ($x, $y) = @_; $x .= "!"; "$x$y" } print c1(1, 2);   perl 1!2   base: SBCL type error, whole program dies
CAUSE: VarAnnotator gives a parameter the str-buffer verdict (append-only), p-raw-params' param entry carries the class `:str-buffer`, and the macro IGNORED the class -- so the slot held the argument, and %pcl-str-append met a number/box.
FIX: %p-param-init wraps a :str-buffer entry's initform in %pcl-str-buffer (the declaration's own store discipline, _wrap_freeze).  #2514 would have made this reachable from every signature sub with an appended parameter.  Guard: perf-levers-07.t "#2571 str-buffer parameter".
=== DONE (s501q) ===
subject: CRASH (fixed s501q): a p-raw-params parameter with the :str-buffer verdict was bound to the raw argument and died at its first `.=` ("is not an array with a fill pointer")
